title: Director Liability Protection and the Quality of Independent Directors
eligible_reason: Single adoption date: the 1999 Ninth Circuit Silicon Graphics ruling; treat = firms in Ninth Circuit states, post = year >= 1999 (1996-2002 window). Baseline (Table 2) and dynamic DiD (Table 3) are Poisson (ppmlhdfe) with director, board and firm controls; univariate DiD (Table 2a) uses reghdfe with firm FE only and no year FE. No staggered adoption; nonlinear model with controls.
design_notes: Package: README.txt, 'code for main tables.do' (Stata 17; Tables 1-12, Figures 1-2), Codebook.xlsx, datasets/info_newdir.dta (new independent director appointments), info_newdir_adjacent.dta, matchv_adjacent.dta, multiYs.dta, info_leftdir.dta, change_ROA.dta.
